description: Read, create and edit Google Slides presentations: summaries, slides, text, images, reordering and thumbnails.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

name: gslides
title: Google Slides

tools.description: Create a new presentation with the given title
tools.name: createPresentation
tools.title: Create a presentation

tools.description: Get a presentation's title, slide count, page size and a per-slide summary (title and body preview)
tools.name: getPresentation
tools.title: Read a presentation

tools.description: Get a slide's page elements with their types and text previews
tools.name: getSlide
tools.title: Read a slide

tools.description: Add a slide with a predefined layout and optional title/body text, at an optional position. Resolves the layout's title and body placeholders and writes the text in the same call.

body.description: Body text written into the layout's body placeholder

index.description: Zero-based position for the new slide; omitted appends at the end

layout.description: Predefined layout for the new slide

title.description: Title text written into the layout's title placeholder

tools.name: addSlide
tools.title: Add a slide

tools.description: Replace the title and/or body text of a slide: finds its title and body placeholders and rewrites them

body.description: New body text for the slide's body placeholder

title.description: New title text for the slide's title placeholder

tools.name: setSlideText
tools.title: Set a slide's text

tools.description: Insert an image from a public URL onto a slide, with optional size and position in inches. When no size is given the image keeps its default size.

height_inches.description: Image height in inches; omitted keeps the image's natural height for the chosen width, or its default size when width is also omitted

image_url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image (PNG, JPEG or GIF, under 50 MB)

width_inches.description: Image width in inches; omitted keeps the image's default size

x_inches.description: Horizontal position in inches from the slide's left edge; omitted puts the image at the left edge

y_inches.description: Vertical position in inches from the slide's top edge; omitted puts the image at the top edge

tools.name: addImage
tools.title: Add an image

tools.description: Replace all occurrences of a text string across the whole presentation or selected slides

page_ids.description: Slide object IDs to limit the replacement to; omitted replaces across the whole presentation

text.description: The text to find and replace

tools.name: replaceText
tools.title: Replace text

tools.description: Delete a slide from the presentation
tools.name: deleteSlide
tools.title: Delete a slide

tools.description: Set the full new order of the presentation's slides: slide_ids lists every slide ID in the desired order

slide_ids.description: Every slide's object ID, in the desired new order

tools.name: reorderSlides
tools.title: Reorder slides

tools.description: Render a slide as a PNG thumbnail and get its URL. The URL stays valid for about 30 minutes.
tools.name: getSlideThumbnail
tools.title: Get a slide thumbnail

tools.description: Apply raw Slides API batchUpdate request objects (escape hatch for advanced edits like shapes, tables, styling)

requests.description: Slides API request objects, e.g. createShape, createTable, updateTextStyle, updateSlideProperties

write_control.description: Optional write control, e.g. {"requiredRevisionId": "..."} to guard against concurrent edits

tools.name: batchUpdate
tools.title: Apply raw edits
